sum: 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. develops and commercializes AI-powered, laboratory-based blood tests for the early detection and prevention of cancers and chronic diseases. It provides OneTest for Cancer, a multi-cancer early detection, or MCED and OneTest for Longevity, which measures inflammatory biomarkers. It also operates the Clinical Lab Innovation Axcelerator (CLIAx), a CLIA laboratory for overseas diagnostics start-ups. The company was formerly known as 20/20 GeneSystems, Inc. and changed its name to 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. in March 2025. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Gaithersburg, Maryland.
ceo: Mr. Jonathan  Cohen (Founder, CEO, President & Director)
